Keep guest networks isolated while merging data into a new network. Bridging the gap with up to 64 process engines LumiCore enables you to merge and route up to 64 x 4 input sources to 64 newly defined universes (depending on the model). This makes LumiCore the ideal solution for isolating your control setup at festivals, in theaters, or TV studios. As technology advances toward fully networked solutions (such as ArtNet or sACN directly to fixtures), LumiCore offers the same flexibility as LumiNode but operates directly on the network. It supports up to 256 input universes that can be merged and routed to a maximum of 128 output universes—all with extremely low latency. Our splitters are completely configurable through RDM but also offer RDM filtering to prevent issues with non-RDM lighting fixtures. View brochure Lumi-what? LumiSplit is a range of DMX/RDM splitters designed by Luminex. A splitter is a device that takes a DMX line in and repeats it on multiple DMX outputs. This comes in very useful when you have more than 32 lighting fixtures to be controlled on one line. You also need a splitter when you have fixtures in different locations and they cannot be incorporated in a ‘daisy chain’. Advanced RDM features: never climb the truss again. All LumiSplit devices have enhanced RDM features, which enable users to discover, manage and setup every unit directly from any RDM controller. You never have to climb the truss again to change a small setting or patch fixtures. Even future LumiSplit upgrades can be executed over RDM. Finally, forget issues with non-RDM lighting fixtures.
